basic_details.job_title: Civil Court Sheohar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon/ Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 support staff posts (1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon/Orderly) in the Evening Court, Sheohar, on a contractual basis. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheohar, personally or through registered post, on or before 30 November 2026. The notice is dated 17 November 2026 and only retired Civil Court employees may apply.

content_sections.heading: Sheohar District Court Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee, a pay amount or the selection process. It also does not specify a minimum educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: About Sheohar District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheohar, the district judiciary of Sheohar in Bihar. The engagement is for support staff in the Evening Court, Sheohar. The notice has been circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar, and the retirement condition follows guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheohar, on or before 30 November 2026. It can be handed in personally or sent through registered post. The notice uses the word "reach", so an application sent by post should arrive at the office by that date. The notice does not print a prescribed application form, a full postal address with PIN code, an email address or a list of documents to attach. It also does not say what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: These conditions apply to applicants for every post: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records. The applicant should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. Besides the common conditions, an applicant for the Stenographer post must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Besides the common conditions, an applicant for the Clerk post must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Besides the common conditions, an applicant for the Peon/ Orderly post must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The notice prints no pay amount for any post. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No age limit is specified in the notice; eligibility depends on having retired within the period stated above. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in Sheohar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon/Orderly in the Evening Court, Sheohar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Sheohar Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheohar, on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply. They must have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, and must have satisfactory service records with no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Sheohar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application personally or through registered post to the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheohar, so that it reaches on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will the pay of the retired employees be fixed?
faq.answer: The notice prints no amount. The remuneration, period of engagement and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours for these posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates must perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court, Sheohar.

faq.question: Q9. Can the advertisement be cancelled?
faq.answer: Yes. The competent authority reserves the right to cancel or modify the advertisement or the selection process without assigning any reason.
